description: A crepe store sells chocolate and peanut butter crepes. A chocolate crepe requires 3 units of chocolate spread and 6 units of crepe mix. A peanut butter crepe requires 4 units of peanut butter spread and 7 units of crepe mix. Recently, the peanut butter crepe has been more popular and therefore the number of peanut butter crepes made must exceed the number of chocolate crepes made. However at least 25% of the crepes made should be chocolate. The store has available 400 units of chocolate spread and 450 units of peanut butter spread. How many of each should the store make to minimize the total amount of crepe mix needed?

ChocolateSpreadPerChocolateCrepe.definition: Amount of chocolate spread required to make one chocolate crepe

PeanutButterSpreadPerPeanutButterCrepe.definition: Amount of peanut butter spread required to make one peanut butter crepe

CrepeMixPerChocolateCrepe.definition: Amount of crepe mix required to make one chocolate crepe

CrepeMixPerPeanutButterCrepe.definition: Amount of crepe mix required to make one peanut butter crepe

TotalAvailableChocolateSpread.definition: Total available units of chocolate spread

TotalAvailablePeanutButterSpread.definition: Total available units of peanut butter spread

MinimumProportionChocolateCrepes.definition: Minimum proportion of crepes that must be chocolate

objective.description: "Minimize the total amount of crepe mix required to produce the chocolate and peanut butter crepes"

constraints.description: 3 times the number of chocolate crepes made should not exceed the total available chocolate spread
4 times the number of peanut butter crepes made should not exceed the total available peanut butter spread
The number of peanut butter crepes made should be greater than or equal to the number of chocolate crepes made
The number of chocolate crepes made should be at least 25% of the total number of crepes made
The number of chocolate crepes made and the number of peanut butter crepes made should be non-negative

PeanutButterCrepes.definition: Number of peanut butter crepes made
